shortDescription.default: Embeds SAP Signavio process diagrams in SharePoint pages with adjustable size.

longDescription.default: SharePoint Framework web part that displays a shared SAP Signavio process diagram (Simple image link) directly on the page, without an iframe, at a configurable size, with an optional caption, a link to the Signavio Collaboration Hub, zoom and a full-screen view. Follows the page and section theme, works as a Microsoft Teams tab, texts in English, German, French and Spanish.
